notes.title: Innocent Blood Raid
notes.content:
There's a new master quest [i]Innocent Blood[/i]. Can you destroy the dragon deep in the volcano core?

There have also been a large number of other updates:
[list]
[*]There is now an equipment interface where you can see equipment stats and unequip items.
[*]Players can now build barricades to block other players or monsters.
[*]The wasteland has been expanded and there is now a mineable nickel rock.
[*]There are new character configuration options.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the new updates! You can view high scores for the new raid [url=https://news.reconquer.online/highscores/rankings/Overall/Raid%20One]here[/url].
